description: Situated in the sought-after area of Stockton-on-Tees, this well-presented three-bedroom property on Kingfisher Avenue offers a comfortable and practical living space. The home features three spacious bedrooms, a bright and airy living room, and a modern family bathroom. The property is ideal for families or professionals looking for a convenient and welcoming rental option. Located in the TS20 area, the property benefits from excellent local amenities. North Shore Academy and Whitehouse Primary School are within easy reach, providing good educational options for families. For shopping and dining, the nearby Norton High Street offers a variety of independent shops, cafes, and restaurants. Healthcare facilities, including the Norton Medical Centre, are also conveniently located. Transport links are excellent, with easy access to the A19 and A66, making commuting to Middlesbrough, Durham, and surrounding areas straightforward. Stockton train station is a short drive away, providing rail services to regional and national destinations. For outdoor enthusiasts, the property is close to Norton Duck Pond and the scenic Ropner Park, both ideal for leisurely walks and family outings. This property combines modern living with a prime location, making it an excellent choice for tenants seeking comfort and convenience.
